topic: Dashboard map visibility for all customers
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on improving dashboard functionality, specifically regarding the display of location maps. It was requested that map visibility be added to the dashboard for all customers, even those with only one location (e.g., CityMedia). Regarding data sources, it was noted that real-time data source integration is currently limited to AFA and requires development time (estimated 1-2 days) to expand to other customers. Furthermore, improvements to 'sessioner' are needed before map functionality can be fully implemented.
decisions: Map visibility must be added to the dashboard for all customer types, regardless of location count.
action_items: Improvement of the real-time data source is required to expand coverage beyond AFA.
Improvements to 'sessioner' functionality are needed before map implementation can proceed.
